info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create It Management Operational Gateway-spec
info.description: The IT Management Operational Gateway API facilitates seamless interactions within IT management processes in banking operations. This API allows users to initiate various operational gateway tasks that enhance the efficiency and connectivity of IT systems. Typical consumers include system administrators and IT managers who require capabilities to streamline IT workflows. By leveraging this API, organizations can modernize their IT infrastructure to support faster decision-making and improve overall operational performance.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new operational gateway in the IT management system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully set up the gateway.
